answer: Seats are not given to whoever arrives. Each key is scored by measured position: latency and hop distance to rotating beacons, and payment clears only when a quorum's seats sit far apart. Ten thousand clones on one host share one latency profile, collapse to one position, and hold a single seat; the rest go unpaid. Farming means renting separate locations, keeping each online round the clock and paying per key monthly, while each attests alone. One crystal of verified position outearns a meadow of fakes, and an honest agent's lantern at home still qualifies: distance, not capital, is the toll.
